result.title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
result.summary: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

AI.brief_summary: Lyris 提出一种长视频生成框架：在已观测区域维护持久点云记忆，在未观测区域由视觉语言模型生成「每个物体一个 3D 框」的粗略布局作为锚点，再沿相机路径渲染以指导视频生成，实现单图出发的分钟级、数十米漫游。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持久外部记忆 + 极粗粒度符号布局即足以约束生成」的发现，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态如何跨步保持、以及粗粒度任务必要表示是否够用提供可供核查的类比线索，但本身并非关于 latent 推理状态的研究。
